pictures.author: Arne Müseler / arne-mueseler.com
pictures.observations: Aerial view: shallow white annular roof and large elliptical opening, tall white outer collar truss, exposed concrete perimeter frame and covered oval stands around pitch/blue athletics apron. Main structure only; neighboring practice grounds, parking/trees and railway remain native. Photograph viewed only, no pixels copied.

pictures.author: Niki.L
pictures.observations: Close roof underside resolves white inner edge/catwalk, diagonal bracing, radial beams and open central sky. Small handrail/hanger/equipment counts are simplified rather than surveyed.

pictures.author: Tokfo
pictures.observations: Wide exterior panorama shows the continuous white collar truss over exposed upper concrete piers and a pale green two-storey office frontage with regular windows. Stitching and vegetation limit exact frontage extent; vehicles/trees/signs are excluded.

pictures.author: Mister No
pictures.observations: Bowl view corroborates blue athletics surface, blue/yellow seating sectors, horizontal concourses, an end scoreboard and covered stands under the open roof edge. Front crowd barriers/text and exact section/seat inventory are not copied.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Ernst-Happel-Stadion: exact mapped oval roof envelope/opening, closed shallow white annular roof/radial underside beams, white outer collar truss/open inner catwalk, exposed concrete perimeter columns/floor belts, pale green windowed frontage, three covered blue/yellow seating tiers/concourse aisles, blue representative athletics track and football pitch/goals, two supported neutral end boards. Four existing shared concrete/paint/window-grid/canvas graphs. No roof over pitch, unique atlas/copied text/live screens, crowd/event fixtures, furnished offices, neighboring practice ground/railway or whole-site slab.
